name: FY 2017 PMMR Data Extract
description:
This dataset is an extract from a city government's performance management reporting for fiscal year 2017. Each row represents a performance indicator tied to a specific agency and one of 24 goal categories, with a flag marking whether the indicator is considered critical. The data includes actual results for fiscal years 2014, 2015, and 2016, targets for fiscal years 2017 and 2018, and four-month actual figures for fiscal years 2016 and 2017 to allow early-year comparisons. Values are stored as text and mix formats, including numbers, percentages, times, and symbols such as asterisks and arrows, so some cleaning is needed before analysis.

The dataset can be used to track agency progress toward goals, compare actual outcomes with targets, identify critical indicators, and examine year-over-year trends. It supports accountability and transparency reporting, budgeting and resource decisions, and analysis of how agencies performed against their stated objectives.
